narr: A stalled front coupled with weak storm motion resulted in slow moving storms with heavy rainfall and flash flooding.
ev: Significant flooding was observed at the intersection of Needlerush Ct. and North Bald Head Wynd. Flooding was also reported in many other locations on the island.
lsr: SEVERAL INCHES OF WATER OVER THE ROAD AT THE INTERSECTION OF NEEDLERUSH COURT AND NORTH BALD HEAD WYND. FLOODING ALSO REPORTED IN MANY OTHER SPOTS ON AREA ROADS.
